claims.text: The exaggeration rate shown in Figure 3a is calculated based on the trend of exaggeration since 2010, with a Spearman rank correlation coefficient of -0.88 (p-value<0.001).
Years 2008 and 2009 were excluded from the analysis due to insufficient data, which is relevant for understanding the calculation of the rate in Figure 3a.
